items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: And Professor Dart and Professor Ankrum and Professor Ranson and Professor Sawyer and Professor Smalls and Professor J. Donovan Moe, who was still alive in his 90s. Right in the same class now with Dr. Dubois. The two old men look alike. Those men were music instructors

ctx.x: That's right. My mother always talked about him when she was a girl.

And Blind Boone played the piano so skillfully. All the compositions just as perfect. You take the school out here and look at it if you feel like it. Because he came on a concert tour to Charleston. And Professor Dart and Professor Ankrum and Professor Ranson and Professor Sawyer and Professor Smalls and Professor J. Donovan Moe, who was still alive in his 90s.
